name: uthjabsdk-web
description: Full-stack web application and backend server for Uthjabsdk Habit & Timetable Tracker

scripts.build:ui: node scripts/generate-icons.cjs && tsc -p tsconfig.ui.json && node scripts/build-ui.cjs
scripts.test: npm run build:ui && node tests/unit/schedule.cjs && node tests/unit/academic-dates.cjs && node tests/unit/backup.cjs && node tests/unit/radar-triage.cjs && node tests/unit/sync-integration.cjs && node tests/unit/mess-menu.cjs && node tests/unit/mobile-projection.cjs && node tests/unit/mobile-publisher.cjs && node tests/unit/mobile-publish-cases.cjs
scripts.test:browser: npm run build:ui && node tests/browser/routine.cjs && node tests/browser/reminders.cjs && node tests/browser/radar.cjs && node tests/browser/academic.cjs && node tests/browser/update-control.cjs
